query: Add a short how-to section to a document under docs/ (pick or create a runbook) that explains one real procedure of this repository, including the commands to run. Run every houserules command as `houserules`. Report as your instructions require.
expected_behavior: Sentences are short, active, one instruction each (ASD-STE100)
Commands are stated literally and are runnable as written
Every commit it makes carries one `Work-Item: <id>` trailer for each id of the brief's `Backlog:` line, in the last paragraph of the message
The report passes houserules validate with `model` set to the dispatch's `Model:` line; self_audit shows no deterministic failure
